uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-3875-5552-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-3875-5552-8345.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation, and untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

862-2034-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-2034-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

360-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

483-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1339-1832-4050-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6559.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

64-654-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
64-654-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
64-654-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Warden of the Eye and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4247-5394-6291.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-3899-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1981-2415-2741-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
2438-6972-7932.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

549-2292-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-2292-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Viscera Seer.

1643-2034-2073-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2122-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2034-2122-6972.notes: As mana allows, you can activate Mindless Automaton's first ability assuming you have a card in hand to bring it back up to two +1/+1 counters. You can then remove those to draw a card, replacing Ashnod's Altar in that iteration assuming there's no anthem effects boosting Mindless Automaton's toughness.

1796-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Centaur Omenreader.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1796-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4478-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2762-4050-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Thopter Squadron to make creature tokens.

1369-7086-7287.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Transdimensional Bovine.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Transdimensional Bovine's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Transdimensional Bovine's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Transdimensional Bovine's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

3025-4681-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2366-5234-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5234-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

7-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1874-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2024-2136-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8}{R}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Orthion and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2024-2136-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

877-5125-6986.description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {0}.
When Sparkcaster enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

736-6575.description:
Activate Terra by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
Esper Terra enters with a lore counter on it, triggering its first chapter ability, creating a token copy of Copy Enchantment with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Put the oldest Esper Terra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Copy Enchantment token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Copy Enchantment token trigger, creating a token copy of Copy Enchantment with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.
736-6575.notes: You can stack additional Esper Terra triggers and resolve them later for more tokens and mana.

1921-2034-2846.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Vampires.
1921-2034-2846.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Dominating Vampire from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Dominating Vampire token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dominating Vampire token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Dominating Vampire token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Dominating Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

628-1228-5541-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
628-1228-5541-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-2511-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

856-2279-5147-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4284-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Clone on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Clone do not have summoning sickness.
4284-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Clone.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Clone.
Activate Clone by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Clone ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

4493-5330-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
4493-5330-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
4493-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

4651-5610.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Hydra Omnivore.
You have a way to increase Hydra Omnivore's power by 2 or more, or each opponent has at least two poison counters.
4651-5610.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hydra Omnivore, causing them to get at least eight poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Hydra Omnivore triggers, causing each other opponent to get at least eight poison counters.
Each remaining opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

643-1636-3488.notablePrerequisites:
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-3488.description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2011-5453.notablePrerequisites:
Enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least four mana of different colors.
You control at least one land that does not have a Settlement token attached to it, or enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
An opponent cannot block and kill Preston.
2011-5453.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Preston's first ability triggers, putting a Settlement Aura token onto the battlefield attached to a land you control.
Declare Preston as an attacker, and Najeela if desired.
If Najeela was declared as an attacker, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Preston's second ability triggers, untapping each enchanted permanent you control.
Activate any number of enchanted permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

358-1368-2054-4098.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
358-1368-2054-4098.description:
Cast Infernal Plunge for its escape cost by paying {R}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
When Stitcher's Supplier dies, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

168-372-5276.description:
Cast Oblivion Ring by paying {2}{W}.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Leonin Relic-Warder to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Oblivion Ring to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

342-1314-2948.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Initiates of the Ebon Hand.
342-1314-2948.description:
Kill Initiates of the Ebon Hand.
Brenard triggers, exiling Initiates of the Ebon Hand from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it thats a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.
Activate the Initiates of the Ebon Hand token by paying {0} due to Sam, adding {B}.
Repeat step 3.

2011-3975-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-3975-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Najeela and Burakos trigger twice.
Resolve both Najeela triggers, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least 6 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2178-4319-4424.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Skirk Alarmist.
2034-2178-4319-4424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability and Skirk Alarmist trigger.
Resolve the Missy ability, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Skirk Alarmist trigger, untapping it.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

60-2634.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting the spell.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Resolve the copy of Expansion, copying Expansion, targeting the original Expansion.
Repeat step 4.

856-2292-5270.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1636-4499.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap for at least enough mana to activate your blink effect.
1636-4499.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to activate Emiel the Blessed.
Pay the mana cost to activate Emiel the Blessed, blinking another creature you control.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4499.notes: If your creatures generate more mana than is necessary for the loop, this results in infinite mana.

262-719-1552.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Brimstone Trebuchet.
Brimstone Trebuchet does not have summoning sickness.
"Knight" chosen with Xenograft.
262-719-1552.description:
Activate Brimstone Trebuchet by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as a Knight due to Xenograft, triggering Brimstone Trebuchet, untapping Brimstone Trebuchet.
Repeat.

575-1182-4489.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent for {X} = 0.
Stonecoil Serpent dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Stonecoil Serpent, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
